dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin is back up for some reason.

The only reason Dogecoin ever went big was because of how much influence Elon Musk's voice carries.

Lesson in there.
OK I don’t like DogeCoin but this made me laugh 😆

People ridiculed Putin for banning memes

They wouldn’t have done this is they understood just how much power a meme can carry.

DogeCoin is a perfect example of this.
